ModMetaData.name: More Storylike Traits 1.6 (unofficial)
ModMetaData.author: 七彩型七色, DarthCY - 1.6 port: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
UNOFFICIAL. This mod is published without the original author's explicit consent. If the original author contacts me to request its removal, I undertake to take it down promptly.
Fifty-three traits that are people rather than statistics, brought forward from HYP's More Storylike Traits, which stopped at RimWorld 1.3.
The premise of the original was a complaint: a colonist of seventy has exactly two backstories, the same as a colonist of twenty, and almost none of them explain who anyone is. So these are biographies. A streamer run off the air for a clip nobody could explain, still insisting he never cheated. A surgeon who was first among the four great scalpels of his world and cannot be in a room with a patient's family. A man who has lost more empires to wonders than to war and would do it again. A poultry farmer whose cluck brings the whole flock at a run. Someone who signed a contract to save one person and will not say what the terms were.
Every trait is sorted into one of six colour-coded tiers, from grey handicaps through green knacks and blue careers up to five red traits that will bend a colony around them. Rarity falls with power: a green trait is about half as likely as a common vanilla one, and the red ones are a fiftieth. Thirty-one thoughts come with them - what the colony makes of the horror in its midst, what a viking thinks about being handed a rifle, and what happens to a man who has spent all night saying "one more turn".
The text is rewritten in English, not translated word for word. The original is written in Chinese and much of it turns on the jokes of one forum in one decade; a literal pass carries the words and loses the person, which in a mod about people is the whole loss. The Chinese, Simplified and Traditional both, is the original authors' own and is shipped intact.
Nothing here overrides or patches a vanilla def. No dependencies, no Harmony. The assembly is ninety lines and exists only so that one thought can ask what traits somebody else is carrying.
Safe to add to a running colony. Removing it mid-game strips these traits from any pawn who has one, like any content mod.
Not to be run alongside More Storylike Traits - Body and Mind, which is a different treatment of the same source: nineteen of these traits, rewritten and rebalanced to vanilla ceilings, plus Biotech genes. That one holds every number to what vanilla already permits. This one keeps the original's numbers, its tiers and its whole cast. Pick whichever you would rather play.
Credit for the original goes to 七彩型七色 (Hyperion-c) and DarthCY. Their mod declares no licence anywhere and has not been updated since September 2021; this continuation follows the usual Workshop practice for that case - original authorship preserved, and if either author would rather it were not up, say so and it comes down.
